To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) soil compaction significantly reduced the root growth of both crops; (ii) the applied soil amendments increased the root growth of the crops in relation to uncompacted soil; (iii) the magnitude of response of soybean was greater than that of maize.
soil compaction and fertilizer amendment significantly affected the root growth of soybean and maize.
soil compaction significantly reduced the root growth of both maize and soybean and soil amendments, especially poultry manure, improved the root growth and biomass production of both crops.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of soil compaction and soil amendments on the root development and growth of maize and soybeans.
the impact of soil compaction and soil amendments on the root penetration ratio of maize and soybeans in a Ferric acrisol.
the impact of subsurfacce compaction and different soil amendments on root growth of two crops.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the root growth of both maize and soybean was significantly reduced by soil compaction and that the applied soil amendments increased root penetration and shoot biomass of both the crops in relation to control.

the root growth of both crops was significantly influenced by soil compaction and the applied fertilizer amendments, and that the root growth response to the applied fertilizer amendments was greater in the soybean than in the maize.
the root growth of the two crops was adversely affected by subsurface compaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
soil amendments, such as NPK and poultry manure, are useful in improving the root growth of crops and the shoot biomass of soybean and maize.
the application of poultry manure and NPK fertilizer significantly increased the root growth of the crops in the compacted soils.
the application of soil amendments to compacted soil can significantly improve root growth, and thus, increase the yield of maize and soybeans.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the root growth of both maize and soybean was severely impaired by subsurface compaction of the Ferric Acrisols.
the use of poultry manure as a soil amendment can improve root growth of both maize and soybean and increase the shoot biomass of soybean.

root growth of both crops was adversely affected by soil compaction and that application of soil amendments, especially 50% each poultry manure and NPK fertilizer, significantly increased shoot biomass production and root growth of both maize and soybean in a Ferric-Acrisol.
